_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for CS2 Steam app/depot/build/manifest data. Per (build, platform) acquire: binary = builds[].binaries[platform]; content (gameevents) = builds[].content. Any depot's manifest at any build resolves from depots[].history (newest entry whose change_number <= the build's, or date_utc <= the build date). All depots a build touches are tracked for downstream context; we only ACQUIRE content (2347770) + the platform binary depot. Tools (2347779, role=tools) are acquired per build like binaries: the win64 editor-DLL slice merges into the windows binaries dir; builds[].tools is that build's 2347779 manifest GID.
consumers: host acquire --all / --build <id> [...] batch mode (binary manifests via builds[].binaries; AssetsInventory reader)
scripts/backfill-gameevents.py (content GID via builds[].content / content depot history)
_meta.provenance: Manifests are hand-extracted from SteamDB patch pages via the bookmarklet in temp/scripts/ (manual DOM read; -- no scraping); new builds are appended to this inventory by the host on a successful extract --commit (forward-capture), which is now the sole writer. Authoritative entries carry build_id+change_number; date-only entries predate extraction. Verified against committed provenance.json where available.
_meta.era_note: builds[].era = the id of the eras[] entry this build's schema-system layout belongs to (compile-pin or runtime-variant). eras[] defines each era's hl2sdk pin (or ridden pin), per-platform layout signature(s), and class-count band. Maintained by the host on forward-capture.
